content: Proven reusable architecture pattern for GitHub cold repo discovery agents: use Firecrawl map for initial resource discovery, signal grep for token-free self-audit, output graded (A/B/C) curated JSON + Markdown, with CLI entry point at `scripts/github-cold-repo <topic>`, WebUI integration as a Hermes Studio dashboard card, and persistent result storage at `data/github-cold-repo/<date>.json`.
